scope: Sync accepted window-398 video and gate evidence from a800-2
summary: The first sync used an unsupported rsync progress option on macOS; a portable retry completed and verified the candidate hash.
evidence: The local rsync rejected --info=progress2 before transferring the video.
The retry used --progress, transferred the 16 MB candidate, and local SHA-256 equals b53956ff0bf7d62fee7691d1489a06dc5ee599290b7e36c154c3048ce87ad6e6.
Both strict gate reports, manifests, contact-pair files, and review storyboards are present locally.
lessons: Use rsync --progress rather than newer --info syntax on the bundled macOS rsync.
limitations: The failed invocation transferred no candidate video.
next_actions: Use the verified local artifact for review and delivery.
